Subject: Price check after demo / next steps

Hi Tessa + Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier — the team found the latency profile and routing options promising. Procurement ran a competitive process this week and we received a firm replacement offer from ModelServe: $0.0012 per token for generation with a 12-month commitment plus a $40k onboarding credit. They also included a 99.9% SLA and a standard SOC2 report.

Two asks from our side to move forward:
- Can Redwood provide a like-for-like price match (or a competitive packaging alternative) including any onboarding credits?
- We need a short migration plan / playbook that spells out data migration, expected cutover time, and suggested rollback steps.

Attached is the updated RFP with usage profiles and peak month numbers (CloudScale_RFP_v2.pdf). Procurement copied on this thread: procure@cloudscale.ai.

Would you be able to share a preliminary take by mid-week? We’re trying to close vendor selection by Friday.

Thanks,
Amelia Park
Head of Cloud Partnerships
CloudScale

Amelia — appreciate the context and the RFP.

Short answer: yes, we can put together a competitive package. Proposing the following immediate steps so we don’t slow down your procurement window:
1) We’ll produce a replacement playbook that maps to your RFP usage buckets and lists migration tasks, estimated downtime windows, and rollback steps.
2) We’ll run a delta TCO that compares ModelServe’s quote to Redwood under a few commitment tiers and include migration credits.
3) I’ll follow up with an official quote (PDF) and a pricing matrix you can share with procurement.

Can you confirm the expected committed vCPU/GPU footprint during peak month (listed in the RFP as “peak tokens/month”)? If you can’t share exact numbers here, a range is fine — we’ll model several sensitivity scenarios.

Looping in Jordan — he’ll advise on discount tiers and ramp credits.

Next steps: I’ll aim to get the playbook and matrix to you by Wednesday EOD. If Procurement wants a call, happy to schedule a procurement + legal touchpoint.

Best,

Amelia — quick note from pricing: we can match the $0.0012/token competitor figure with a 9–12 month committed arrangement at your current monthly throughput. Alternatively, for a 6-month pilot we can offer $0.00135/token + a $25k migration credit and a guaranteed migration assistance package (engineering sprints, dedicated CSM hours).

A few clarifications that will materially impact the delta:
- Does the competitor pricing include embeddings and reranking at the same unit cost? If not, we’ll need to model those separately.
- Is the $40k onboarding credit tied to professional services or a balance applied to usage?

I’ve created a short pricing matrix and sensitivity tabs — I’ll attach the working XLSX to the package we send.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/CLD-2026-089 (internal tracking)

—Jordan

Thanks Jordan — the competitor price is specific to generation tokens only. Embeddings and reranking are quoted separately. The $40k credit is an onboarding credit (applied against first two months of usage/professional services, flexible).

We’re happy to take the 9–12 month match if you can provide an official quote and an SLA addendum (they required 99.9%). Procurement would like to see SOC2 evidence and a short security checklist as part of the package.

If you can get a draft quote + security checklist by Wednesday EOD that would keep us on track.

—Amelia
